items.title: London-based “Surgical Intelligence” company XRlabs raises €7.48 million to bring AI into the operating room
items.summary: XRlabs, the London-based Surgical Intelligence company built by surgeons for surgeons, has raised €7.48 million ($8.4 million) in Seed funding. The round was led by Playground Global, the DeepTech-focused venture firm based in Palo Alto, with participation from London-based HealthTech investor Eka Ventures. items.title: London’s Emerald secures €1.66 million to scale its preventive healthcare platform
items.summary: Emerald, a London-based preventive healthcare platform, has secured an additional €1.66 million (£1.4 million/$1.85 million) in funding. This brings the company’s total funding to date to €3.44 million (£2.9 million).
